content: codex-claude-bridge documents and recommends exactly two Codex models: `gpt-6-astra` as the default current flagship and `gpt-5.6-sol` as the fallback. This recommendation boundary scopes defaults, README/model tables, error tips, and CLI/MCP help; explicitly configured other model IDs are still forwarded unchanged rather than blocked. Curate recommendations without gating user autonomy.
context: Policy originally captured after the 2026-04-23 model cleanup and recommend-not-enforce rollback. Updated 2026-07-09 for GPT-5.6 Sol, and again 2026-09-04 after GPT-6 Astra release: the Codex CLI 0.153.4 catalog lists `gpt-6-astra` as the newest flagship, so the pair advanced from Sol/5.5 to Astra/Sol and the SDK pin moved 0.144.0 -> 0.153.4. Same day, provider-neutral tiers were added (`TIER_MODELS` in src/config/types.ts): max/balanced/fast map to Astra/Sol/Luna on Codex and 3.1 Pro (High)/3.5 Flash (High)/3.5 Flash (Medium) on Gemini. Luna is a tier target, not a third recommended model: RECOMMENDED_MODELS stays the pair for error tips. Keep this lesson, README, RECOMMENDED_MODELS, TIER_MODELS, backend default, SDK pin, and help/error examples synchronized on future flagship releases.
title: Recommend gpt-6-astra + gpt-5.6-sol only; never block the user's model choice
